name: Phillip Island Grand Prix Circuit
coordinates: x east, z south, y up; meters
bank_convention: Positive bank raises the geometric left road edge relative to center

metadata.layout: Grand Prix circuit (4.448 km, 12 turns), anti-clockwise; the only layout, as used since 1988

start_finish.source: Approximate: point on the Gardner Straight level with the middle of the pit lane (OSM way 1436851709), projected onto the OSM circuit line. No open aerial imagery; the 10 m Sentinel-2 imagery cannot show the painted grid, and OSM has no start/finish node here.

width.status: Published width; no open imagery fine enough to measure edges

elevation.name: Geoscience Australia DEM of Australia derived from LiDAR 5 m (DEM_LiDAR_5m_2025)
elevation.bank: DEM cross slope between the measured edges, median and Gaussian smoothed, clamped to 8 degrees

imagery.name: Sentinel-2 L2A true colour (TCI), scene S2B_55HCT_20260923_0_L2A (2026-09-23, 0.24% cloud), Element84 Earth Search
imagery.license: Copernicus Sentinel data terms (free, full and open)

metadata.license: Open Database License 1.0 (ODbL) for OSM derived geometry, separate from repository MIT source code
metadata.attribution: OpenStreetMap contributors; Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2026; © Commonwealth of Australia (Geoscience Australia)
limitations: Centerline is OSM geometry recentred on imaged pavement, not a survey
Kerb positions come from imagery colour; kerb height reuses Thunderhill's provisional profile
Grip, run-off surfaces, walls and barriers are not modelled
